race.description: Tabtouch Regional Championship Heat -The Road To Ascot (Rs0mw)
race.comment: IN SITU (4) has the right profile to be the one to beat after a decisive course-and-distance win as odds-on favourite, and his narrow second to CHAMPEZE two runs back came despite racing wide throughout. Maps to be prominent throughout and he can continue his winning ways. SCURGEOFTHEWEST (1) resumes with a very strong overall record and two wins from three attempts at this track and distance, so he has the class to test IN SITU. The claim comes in handy and he's sure to be flying late in the race. VERSAILLE (10) was strong winning fresh in CL2 company at this venue. Can play a leading role second-up if he runs up to to what he did fresh. GILES (6) brings winning form from 1413m and had a bit in reserve. Back in trip is a query but he has to be included on that last start performance. DEEP DISCRETION (5) comes through the same race as IN SITU last start and has claims with the fresh run under his belt.
